question.text: The centres of two circles $C_1$ and $C_2$ each of unit radius are at a distance of 6 units from each other. Let $P$ be the mid-point of the line segment joining the centres of $C_1$ and $C_2$ and $C$ be a circle touching circles $C_1$ and $C_2$ externally. solution.text:

$$ \begin{array}{lc} \Rightarrow & r^2+8=\alpha^2 \\ \Rightarrow & r^2+2 r+1=r^2+8+9 \\ \Rightarrow & 2 r=16 \Rightarrow r=8 \end{array} $$
